The component also supports the common properties [`id`](../common-properties/#id), [`hidden`](../common-properties/#hidden), [`grid`](../grid/), and [`pageBreak`](../page-break/).

| Property                             | Type                           | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                 |
| ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------ | -------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `type`                               | `"IFrame"`                     | Yes      |         | Identifies which component type this configuration represents.                                                                                              |
| `textResourceBindings`               | `object`                       | No       |         | Connects component texts to text resources or expressions.                                                                                                  |
| `textResourceBindings.title`         | `string \| expression<string>` | No       |         | The content of the IFrame. Can for example be set to a string containing HTML, a text resource key, or an expression looking up a value from the data model |
| `sandbox`                            | `object`                       | No       |         |                                                                                                                                                             |
| `sandbox.allowPopups`                | `boolean`                      | No       | `false` | Sets "allow-popups" in the sandbox attribute on the iframe. See: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/iframe#sandbox                   |
| `sandbox.allowPopupsToEscapeSandbox` | `boolean`                      | No       | `false` | Sets "allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox" in the sandbox attribute on the iframe. See: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/iframe#sandbox |
